soundness_flags.label: def:feasible-repair, def:wasserstein-confidence-set, thm:collision-uniform-root-n
soundness_flags.one_line: Armwise sample analogues are undefined on samples with no observations in an arm, and the asserted measurable minimum-distance selection lacks a specified measurable observed-summary image or a selection theorem; this conflicts with the claimed total estimator on every sample.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:gap-free-positive-measure-modulus and its law-level consequences
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The result is conditional on known fixed k and the exact proxy causal structure, compact support, uniform joint latent-arm positivity, and uniform latent proxy-rank margins defining M; it does not settle the full VMW class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Gap-free quotient-law stability, estimation, and confidence claims hold only UNDER the uniformly conditioned causal VMW submodel M.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:labeled-weight-upper through prop:same-class-labeled-minimax
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Ordered latent weights are considered only on the additional distinct-effect, two-sided g-window stratum.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The clipped inverse-gap frontier holds only UNDER M(g), not at equality or with unknown effect ordering.

The abstract states the local minimax rate n^{-1/(4(m-m0)+2)} around an m0-component ordinary mixing distribution fitted with m components, contrasting it with pointwise root-n behavior.
